onthisday.text: The Soviet Red Army shelled the village of Mainila and then claimed that the fire originated from Finland, giving them a casus belli to launch the Winter War a few days later.
The Bolshevik–Makhnovist conflict resumes with a surprise attack by the Red Army against the Makhnovshchina.
In a friendly-fire incident, a skirmish occurred between U.S.-led NATO forces and Pakistani security forces at two military checkposts along the Afghanistan–Pakistan border.
Mars Science Laboratory, a NASA mission carrying the rover Curiosity (pictured) on board, was launched from Cape Canaveral.
A coordinated group of shooting and bombing attacks across Mumbai began, ultimately killing 175 people and wounding more than 300 others.
Six robbers broke into a Brink's-Mat warehouse at Heathrow Airport in London and stole £26 million in gold, diamonds and cash.
Pakistan International Airlines Flight 740, crashed shortly after takeoff near Taif, Saudi Arabia, killing all 156 people on board.
A speaker claiming to represent the "Intergalactic Association" interrupted a broadcast of Southern Television in South East England.
Astérix (prototype pictured), the first French satellite, was launched into orbit by a Diamant rocket from Hammaguir, Algeria.
A riot involving infantrymen, military police, and local law enforcement officers killed three people in Phoenix, Arizona.
Casablanca, starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premiered at the Hollywood Theatre in New York City to coincide with the Allied invasion of French North Africa and the capture of Casablanca.
World War II: The first meeting of the Anti-Fascist Council for the National Liberation of Yugoslavia was convened at Bihać in northwestern Bosnia.
The Iron Guard killed 64 political detainees at a penitentiary near Bucharest and followed up with several high-profile assassinations, including that of former Romanian prime minister Nicolae Iorga.

Being unable to resolve disputes with Eddie Livingstone, owner of the Toronto Blueshirts, the other ice hockey clubs of Canada's National Hockey Association officially agreed to break away and form the National Hockey League.
